claims.text: Named Entity Recognition (NER) in the biomedical domain involves recognizing entities such as proteins, genes, diseases, treatments, and drugs.
NER is a task within Biomedical Information Extraction that applies Natural Language Processing techniques to extract relevant entities from text.
Recent advancements in NER include the use of deep learning techniques, such as recurrent neural networks, to improve performance in biomedical text.
NER systems face challenges due to ambiguities in biomedical literature, which can lead to semantic drift in entity recognition.
NER classifiers can be trained using various features, including POS tags and contextual indicators, to improve precision in identifying biomedical entities.
